transfer-bench-300-lbs-weight-capacity-2.description: The Dalton Medical transfer bench is a bathtub transfer bench with a blow-molded seat and backrest, a textured nonslip seating surface and drainage holes that help prevent water accumulation. Its rust-resistant aluminum frame adjusts in seat height from 18.5 to 22.5 inches, and the reversible design accommodates right- or left-facing entry. It comes two benches per case.

16-in-reclining-wheelchair-w-legrest-ant.description: The Dalton Medical 16-inch reclining wheelchair is a manual chair with hydraulic-assisted recline from 90 to 180 degrees on a carbon-steel frame with a silver-vein finish. It comes with a headrest extension, elevating leg rests, anti-tippers and wheel locks, and its padded, flame-retardant nylon upholstery and padded armrests add comfort. Molded 24-inch rear wheels, 8-inch front casters and a 250 lb weight capacity round out the chair.

36-inx80-inx6-in-450lb-wt-cap-advantage-.description: The Dalton Medical Advantage 10 LTC is a gel-infused pressure-redistribution mattress measuring 42 x 80 x 6 inches with a 600 lb weight capacity. Three layers of medical-grade foam draw heat away from the skin, a 30-degree slope at the foot suspends the heel area, and the PTSS Rail System gives firmer edge support for transfers and edge-of-bed sitting. A stretch nylon top cover and waterproof vinyl bottom cover protect the core, and it meets CFR 1632 and CFR 1633 flammability standards.
features: Advanced Temperature Regulation: Gel-infused foam directs heat away from the skin, drastically reducing perspiration and the risk of maceration.

Superior Pressure Redistribution: Provides optimized support rather than deep cradling at higher compression levels, distributing weight across a larger surface area to prevent static fatigue and pressure ulcers.

Targeted Heel Protection: Features a specialized 30-degree slope at the foot of the bed. This design suspends the vulnerable heel area and effectively disperses pressure up through the entire lower leg.
Safer Transfers: Equipped with the PTSS Rail System, giving firmer edge support to enable safe, trouble-free patient transfers and secure edge-of-bed sitting.
Top Cover: Stretch nylon material reduces shear and friction. It is fluid-resistant, anti-bacterial, and breathable to further reduce perspiration.
Bottom Cover: Heavy-duty triple laminate vinyl provides a completely waterproof, anti-bacterial barrier to protect the mattress core and ensure longevity.
Safety & Compliance: Fully meets CFR 1632 and CFR 1633 flammability standards.

It measures 36 x 80 x 6 inches, supports up to 350 lbs and includes a removable, fluid-resistant, vapor-permeable nylon cover.

Advanced Nylon Cover: Includes a removable nylon cover that is low-shear, fluid-resistant, water-resistant, and vapor-permeable, allowing moisture to escape while protecting the foam from spills.
Latex-Free Construction: Made from durable, latex-free foam developed to maintain its structural integrity through extended clinical use.
Certified Safety: Fully meets CFR 1632 and CFR 1633 flammability standards, ensuring it is safe and compliant for regulated care environments.
Bariatric Option Available: Offered in a standard 36-inch width supporting up to 350 lbs, as well as an expanded 42-inch (B-MATT-M242) width to safely support up to 500 lbs.

acute-care-hospital-bed-with-boards-and-.description: The Dalton Medical acute care hospital bed comes with boards and rails and adjusts in height from 15.7 to 30.7 inches, with backrest, knee-break, heel-lift and Trendelenburg positioning. Double-sided CPR release levers, a central locking system for all 6-inch casters and soft-lowering rails with built-in nurse controls support caregivers. The 80-inch deck extends to 84 or 88 inches without tools, and the composite deck boards remove for cleaning.
features: Double-Sided CPR Release: Equipped with emergency CPR levers on both sides of the backrest, allowing caregivers to instantly lower the patient to a flat surface in critical, time-sensitive situations.

Full Central Locking System: Features an easily accessible pedal system that simultaneously locks all 6-inch casters, ensuring the bed remains entirely stationary during transfers. The casters can also be set to a directional lock for smooth, straight corridor transport.

Built-In Length Extension: The bed deck can be effortlessly extended from a standard 80 inches to 84 or 88 inches in length without the need for any additional tools, seamlessly accommodating taller patients.
Fixed Position Headboard: The headboard remains fixed in place regardless of the bed’s articulation, providing caregivers with unobstructed, stable access to the patient’s head and neck area.
Removable Composite Deck: The sleep surface is constructed from high-quality composite deck boards that can be quickly removed, making deep cleaning and infection control procedures highly efficient.

compressor-nebulizer-dog.description: The Dalton Pediatric Dog Nebulizer is a lightweight nebulizer perfect for those who need to maintain proper lung function. Its small compact design makes it highly portable for use while away from home. The Dalton Dog Nebulizer provides fast, efficient, and reliable drug delivery to kids and patients at home or on the go. Kids with respiratory difficulties, such as Asthma, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), or Cystic Fibrosis, receive doctor prescriptions for medications that minimize or manage the symptoms of their disease. These medications are often in liquid form, requiring nebulization to deliver to the lungs. This machine turns liquid medicine into fine mist so that it can be more easily inhaled into the lungs.
features: Attractive White & Black design for pediatric users
Disposable Cup, Mouthpiece, Tubing (7 ft.), Filters (5 pcs.) and Pediatric Mask

digital-weight-scale-for-patient-lifter-.description: The Dalton Medical digital weight scale attaches to a patient lift's boom and has a maximum capacity of 1100 lb with a 1000 lb safety load limit. A 0.7-inch backlit display and front-panel keys provide Tare, Manual Zero, Hold and unit selection between LB, KG and user-defined units. It runs on three AA 1.5V batteries (not included) and includes the bushing, pins, split rings and converter for attachment.
features: Heavy-Duty Capacity: Features an impressive maximum weight capacity of 1100 lbs (with a 1000 lb safety load limit), making it highly suitable for both standard and bariatric patient monitoring.
Clear Visibility: Equipped with a 0.7″ numerical display and adjustable backlight settings, ensuring weight readings are highly visible in any lighting condition.
Versatile Functionality: Intuitive front-panel keys allow caregivers to easily use Tare (in/out), Manual Zero, and Hold (lock/unlock) functions.
Unit Flexibility: A dedicated Unit button allows you to effortlessly switch between pounds (LB), kilograms (KG), and user-defined units (UN).

Energy Efficient: Powered by three standard AA 1.5V batteries (not included), the scale offers an average battery life of 65 hours and features customizable Auto-Off and Auto-Sleep modes to preserve power.
Complete Hardware Kit: Includes all necessary assembly components—a bushing, two pins, two split rings, and a converter—ensuring a secure and correctly aligned attachment to your lift’s boom.

divided-leg-sling.description: The Dalton Medical divided leg sling is a padded patient-lift sling made of breathable polyester for use in wet and dry environments. Its divided-leg design makes it easier to apply and remove, and built-in head support stabilizes the head and neck. Weight capacity is 450 lbs in small and medium and 600 lbs in large, and the sling is machine washable.
features: Premium Polyester Fabric: Made from breathable, high-quality polyester, this sling is designed for use in both wet and dry environments. It is highly durable, easy to clean, and fully machine washable (air dry at low temperatures) to help maintain a sanitary caregiving environment.
Padded Comfort: The thoughtfully padded design reduces pressure points and minimizes patient discomfort, ensuring a smoother and safer overall lifting experience.
Divided-Leg Design: The divided-leg construction allows for proper ergonomic positioning, making it easier for caregivers to apply and remove the sling without having to move the patient excessively.

Integrated Head Support: Built-in head support stabilizes and protects the head and neck. This is a crucial feature for patients who lack head control, providing them with enhanced security and peace of mind during transfers.

Heavy-Duty Support: Built to accommodate a variety of body types, the sling features a robust weight capacity ranging from 450 lbs (small, medium) up to 600 lbs (large, extra large), making it suitable for both regular and bariatric use.

specs.label: Maintenance
specs.value: Machine washable; air dry at low temperatures

expandable-36-in-42-in-ltc-low-bed-w-usb.description: The Dalton Medical BED-BC337 is an expandable long-term care low bed whose sleeping surface adjusts to 35, 39 or 42 inches wide and 80, 84 or 88 inches long. It electrically lowers to approximately 7 inches from the floor and offers auto-contour, Trendelenburg and reverse Trendelenburg positioning, a staff control panel with lockouts and a hand pendant with electronic CPR lowering. USB ports, underbed lighting and central locking are built in, with a 600 lbs safe working load.
features: Expandable sleeping surface for greater flexibility
Electrically lowers to approximately 7″ from the floor
Built-in staff control panel with function lockouts
Hand pendant with electronic CPR-lowering function
USB charging ports for compatible personal devices
Underbed lighting supports safer nighttime visibility
Central locking system with conveniently positioned pedals
Multiple mounting positions for compatible rails and assist bars

specs.label: Optional
specs.value: Battery backup, compatible bed rails and assist bars.

full-body-mesh-sling.description: The Dalton Medical full body mesh sling is made of breathable polyester mesh that drains water and dries quickly, making it suited to bathing and wet use. It supports the patient from the head and neck down to the thighs, and reinforced strap attachment points work with most major patient lifts. Machine washable and offered in multiple sizes.
features: Breathable Mesh Fabric: Constructed from durable, high-quality polyester mesh, this sling allows water to drain easily and dries quickly. It is highly resistant to moisture buildup, easy to clean, and fully machine washable (air dry at low temperatures) for maximum infection control.

Comprehensive Full Body Support: Designed to support the patient securely from the head and neck all the way down to the thighs, offering essential stability for patients lacking head or neck control.

Enhanced Comfort: The flexible mesh material comfortably contours to the patient’s body, helping to evenly distribute weight, reduce pressure points, and prevent skin shear during lifts and transfers.
Universal Compatibility: Featuring reinforced, heavy-duty strap attachment points, the LPS27 is universally compatible and can be safely used with most major patient lifts

Heavy-Duty Capacity: Built to safely and securely accommodate a wide range of body types, the sling supports up to 450 lbs for the Medium size and up to an impressive 600 lbs for both the Large and X-Large sizes.

Its polyester mesh drains water and dries quickly for showering and bathing, and it supports the patient from the head and neck down to the thighs. Reinforced attachment points pair with most major patient lifts, and weight capacity is 450 lbs or 600 lbs depending on size.

It is also completely machine washable (air dry at low temperatures) to ensure optimal sanitary conditions.

Comprehensive Full Body Support: Designed to comfortably cradle the patient from the head and neck down to the thighs, offering vital stability and peace of mind for patients who lack head, neck, or trunk control.

Heavy-Duty Support: Built to securely accommodate standard and bariatric needs, the sling supports up to 450 lbs for the Medium size and up to a robust 600 lbs for the Large size.

The Dalton Medical iSeries Full-Electric Bed is a 3 in 1 bed that combines dependable performance hi-low adjustability, patient comfort, and convenient operation in a durable, modern design. Ideal for homecare and healthcare environments, this bed features electric head and knee positioning controlled by an easy-to-use hand pendant, while bed height is adjusted manually using a hand crank. 

Designed with both patients and caregivers in mind, the iSeries features an enhanced headboard and footboard attachment system with integrated locking mechanisms for added stability. Four locking casters provide secure positioning, while the convenient one-touch “All Up” and “All Down” controls simplify head and knee adjustments.

With a 450 lb. safe working load, sturdy construction, and a 35" x 80" sleeping surface, the iSeries Semi-Electric Bed delivers reliable functionality, comfort, and everyday convenience.
